Along the way, it gives you a glimpse into the dark heart of a dangerous romance. releases.title: Mad Money
releases.synopsis: Mad Money is an American finance television program hosted by Jim Cramer that began airing on CNBC on March 14, 2005. Its main focus is investment and speculation, particularly in publicly traded stocks. In a notable departure from the CNBC programming style prior to its arrival, Mad Money presents itself in an entertainment-style format rather than a news broadcasting one. Cramer defines "mad money" as the money one "can use to invest in stocks ... not retirement money, which you want in 401K or an IRA, a savings account, bonds, or the most conservative of dividend-paying stocks." Mad Money replaced Dylan Ratigan's Bullseye for the 6 p.m. Eastern Time slot. On January 8, 2007, CNBC began airing reruns of the show at 11 p.m. Eastern Time, on Monday through Friday, and at 4 a.m. Eastern Time, on Saturdays.In March 2012, the program became a part of what was formerly branded as NBC All Night in the nominal 3:07 a.m. ET/2:07 a.m. timeslot on weeknights, replacing week-delayed repeats of NBC's late night talk shows. In that form, only the video for the program was presented on a 16:9 screen with gray branded windowboxing andpillarboxing, with all enhanced business information, including the CNBC Ticker, removed. Because of the scheduling of local station's 4 a.m. or 4:30 a.m. newscasts to airEarly Today depending on how a station schedules its overnight programming (even if it airs at the regular time in the Eastern and Pacific time zones for instance, seven minutes would have to be cut-off to fit in Early Today and a local newscast starting at 4:30 a.m.), it is subject to local pre-emption, including by NBC O&O's.On August 4, 2014, Mad Money was first broadcast in full 1080i HD, resulting in the removal of the sidebar that was seen on all of CNBC's other trading-day programming, until the sidebar itself was permanently removed altogether on October 13, 2014. The NBC presentation displays the native widescreen HD picture, albeit with the CNBC Ticker space still filled in with gray windowboxing.

releases.title: Fast Money
releases.synopsis: Fast Money is a lively hour of exchange and debate takes place among four of Wall Street's leading traders. Segments include a look at the day's business-related stories in Page Two; the Takedown, in which panelists disagree and argue their points; the Chart of the Day, which offers a look at the stock of the day; and Trade School, in which host Melissa Lee defines Wall Street jargon used by a panelist or a guest.

releases.title: El Señor de los Cielos
releases.synopsis: Set in the 1990s, these are the life and times of Amado Carrillo Fuentes, a man who became the head of the Juárez cartel. Nicknamed “El Señor de los Cielos” (Lord of the Skies) because of the large fleet of airplanes he used to transport drugs, he was also known for washing more than $200 million through Colombia to finance his huge fleet. He is described as the most powerful drug trafficker of his time.

releases.title: Fast Money Halftime Report
releases.synopsis: The hot trades in the market from the floor of the New York Stock Exchange.

releases.title: Bloomberg Markets: Balance of Power
releases.synopsis: In Bloomberg Markets: Balance of Power, host David Gura focuses on the politics and policies being shaped by President Trump's administration.

releases.title: Squawk Box
releases.synopsis: Squawk Box is a business news television program that airs at breakfast time on the CNBC network. The program is currently co-hosted by Joe Kernen, Rebecca Quick, and Andrew Ross Sorkin. Since debuting in 1995, the show has spawned a number of versions across CNBC's international channels, many of which employ a similar format. The program title originates from a term used in investment banks and stock brokerages for a permanent voice circuit or intercom used to communicate stock deals or sales priorities; it also may refer to the squawk of a bird, like a peacock, which is the logo of CNBC.

releases.title: Squawk on the Street
releases.synopsis: Squawk on the Street is headquartered live on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange. We are there when the all-important opening bell rings every day. With our exclusive "Eye on the Floor" wireless cameras at the NYSE we take the viewer onto the floor of the exchange, right to the posts where the biggest companies in the world trade. In addition, our exclusive "Tick by Tick" charts track the action of every trade of every stock. Our live market coverage doesn't stop on the corner of Wall and Broad Streets in lower Manhattan. We also have exclusive coverage from the floor of the CME Group in Chicago giving our viewers the treasury, currency and commodity action in real time. In addition, "Squawk on the Street" is also on the air when the closing bells ring throughout Europe. That final hour of European trading starting at 10:30am eastern has proven to be very volatile and has a major impact on all U.S. based markets.

releases.title: NBC News Daily
releases.synopsis: NBC News provides viewers with up-to-the-minute national and international news.

releases.title: Power Lunch
releases.synopsis: Power Lunch takes you through the heart of the business day, focusing on real-time market coverage, breaking news and up-to-the-instant stock information. The show delves into the economy, the markets, real estate, media and technology -- any place where there's money to be made. The program features daily contributions from the Nasdaq MarketSite's Times Square studio and coverage from CNBC's Post 9 position on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange, as well as from CNBC's bureaus around the world. "Power Lunch" showcases the best stories of the day from CNBC's roster of digital and television journalists.

releases.title: Closing Bell
releases.synopsis: Anything can happen between the bells of the trading day. But what happens during the last hour could be what matters most. Hosted by CNBC's Scott Wapner, "Closing Bell" guides you through the most important hour of the trading day. The show takes a close-up look at how the markets are moving, what's driving them and how investors are reacting.Live coverage includes reports from the Chicago Board of Trade, New York Mercantile Exchange, NASDAQ and the NYSE. Analysts, money managers and CEOs explain their strategies, share opinions, and provide an inside perspective on breaking news stories.In addition, "Closing Bell" provides instant analysis of corporate profit reports, as soon as they break, during the quarterly earning seasons. Features include interviews with entrepreneurs, plus an inside-look at how executives and high-net-worth individuals spend their time and money.

releases.title: Na Wspólnej
releases.synopsis:
Na Wspólnej is a Polish soap opera. It has been running since 2003 on the TVN channel as its flagship primetime weekday soap opera. It is loosely based on the German production Unter Uns and it follows the lives of the inhabitants of an apartment block in Wspólna Street, Warsaw. Episodes tend to last around 20 minutes. It is a Polish version of the Hungarian "Barátok közt".

The series is shot almost entirely in Warsaw and produced by the Polish branch of Freemantle Media. On 9 September 2008 it celebrated its 1000th episode; "Na Wspólnej" was the fourth Polish television series ever to achieve such status. A special episode was broadcast in which characters from some other of TVN's most popular shows visited Wspólna Street.

releases.title: 5 News at 5
releases.synopsis: National and international news.

releases.title: Blossom through the Cloud
releases.synopsis: After becoming a top pilot, Ruan Sixian reunites with Fu Mingyu as love, ambition, and misunderstandings test their bond.

releases.title: The Rachel Maddow Show
releases.synopsis: The Rachel Maddow Show is a daily news and opinion television program that airs on MSNBC, running in the 9:00 pm ET timeslot. It is hosted by Rachel Maddow, who gained popularity with her frequent appearances as a liberal pundit on various MSNBC programs. It is based on her former radio show of the same name. The show debuted on September 8, 2008.

releases.title: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia
releases.synopsis: Four egocentric friends run a neighborhood Irish pub in Philadelphia and try to find their way through the adult world of work and relationships. Unfortunately, their warped views and precarious judgments often lead them to trouble, creating a myriad of uncomfortable situations that usually only get worse before they get better.

releases.title: Villa der Versuchung
releases.synopsis: Villa der Versuchung (German for "Villa of Temptation") is a reality TV series where 14 celebrities move into a paradise villa for two weeks, with every attempt at comfort or luxury costing them from a €250,000 prize pool, as orchestrated by Verona Pooth.

releases.title: EastEnders
releases.synopsis: The everyday lives of working-class residents of Albert Square, a traditional Victorian square of terrace houses surrounding a park in the East End of London's Walford borough.

releases.title: The Moment with Katy Tur
releases.synopsis: The Moment with Katy Tur is designed to move beyond the immediate headlines to provide deeper context and understanding of the political and national stories shaping the day.

releases.title: The Bodies on the Bridge
releases.synopsis: In July 2024, the discovery of two suitcases containing human remains on Bristol's iconic Clifton Suspension Bridge shocked the nation and sparked one of the UK's most disturbing murder investigations in recent memory. The Bodies on the Bridge follows the investigation from the moment police are alerted to a man wheeling a heavy suitcase across a bridge in the early hours of the morning. When officers discover human remains inside two abandoned suitcases, detectives launch an urgent hunt to identify the victims and track down the person responsible. With unprecedented access to the court proceedings, investigators, police officers, journalists and friends connected to the case, the two-part special explores the murders of Albert Alfonso and Paul Longworth and uncovers their complex relationship with Yostin Mosquera, who was found guilty of the murders of the pair.

releases.title: Chronicles of the Sun
releases.synopsis: Claire is surprised when she gets arrested for the murder of her childhood friend after she returns to Montpellier.

releases.title: Paradise Hotel
releases.synopsis: A group of hot singles check into a luxury hotel in Mexico. Prepare for love, partying, betrayal and tears. Half a million kronor is at stake and anything can happen in paradise.

releases.title: Mornings with FOX Business
releases.synopsis: This early show that features a roundtable of rotating industry experts alongside the host. Guests discuss news stories -- domestic and international -- and other topics that are expected to impact the economy and markets that day. The show's intent is to give viewers a jump-start on making moves to get the most out of their investments.

releases.title: TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle
releases.synopsis: America's feel-good morning show with big stars and sweet surprises; Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones host an hour of heartfelt connection, inspirational stories, fun and laughs.

releases.title: NBC Sunday Night Baseball
releases.synopsis: The new Sunday Night Baseball package marks the return of Major League Baseball to NBC for the first time in more than two decades. The debut marks the beginning of a new three-year partnership between NBCUniversal and Major League Baseball and it comes on the heels of the debut season of Sunday Night Basketball, the first of an 11-year agreement between NBCU and the NBA.

releases.title: Пора на завод
releases.synopsis: Young and successful Moscow investor Vadim changes his привычный life dramatically for the sake of his love for his girlfriend Tanya. To earn the respect of Tanya's father, Igor Romanovich, a stern foreman and metallurgist, Vadim, who has never even held a plane in his hands, gets a job at an Ural metallurgical plant. The heat of the workshops, the crude humor of his colleagues, and the unbearable physical demands are just a small part of the trials Vadim faces. Will he be able to endure a whole month without his usual comfort, find true friends, and win the respect of the tough metallurgists? And most importantly, what will Vadim have to change in himself in order to finally be accepted as "one of their own"?

releases.title: ABC Prime with Linsey Davis
releases.synopsis: Providing prime-time context and analysis of the day's top stories, as well as in-depth reporting and storytelling from around the country and the globe.

releases.title: Current with Christine Romans
releases.synopsis: As markets open and the day's biggest stories take shape, anchor Christine Romans will translate breaking developments, politics, global news and the economy to help viewers stay informed and understand what's next. The two-hour program will also feature segments on finance, business, technology, AI and other consequential topics, leveraging Romans' role as NBC News' chief business correspondent.

releases.title: CBS News 24/7
releases.synopsis: Live news and top stories on CBS News 24/7.

releases.title: State of Play with Peter Alexander
releases.synopsis: State of Play focuses on authoritative and original reporting, thoughtful conversations, and in-depth analysis of the biggest political and national stories shaping the day,

releases.title: The Faulkner Focus
releases.synopsis: Emmy-winning journalist Harris Faulkner provides the latest news driving the day with insightful analysis and interviews with top newsmakers.

releases.title: On the Line with Alicia Menendez

releases.title: Closing Bell: Overtime
releases.synopsis: A look at after-hours moves, including breaking news, corporate earnings and post-market trading.

releases.title: Fox News @ Night
releases.synopsis: Fox News @ Night is a live hour of hard news and analysis of the most compelling stories from Washington and across the country.

releases.title: Prelude of the White Snake
releases.synopsis: Bai Suzhen has cultivated for five hundred years and is poised to become an immortal, yet an unfinished love tribulation robs her of an important memory. Commanded by the gods, she goes down to the mortal world to seek out Xu Xian and repay his kindness. Along with Xiaoqing, she steps into the human world and crosses paths with Xu Xian, a demon hunter haunted by his family's massacre, and Fahai, a disciple of Jinshan. Together, the four embark on a journey bound by fate.

releases.title: America Reports
releases.synopsis: A look at the latest news and headlines with Sandra Smith and John Roberts

releases.title: Bloomberg: The Close
releases.synopsis: Alix Steel, Romaine Bostick and Scarlet Fu own the market-moving breaking news around the closing bell; a synthesis focusing on the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street.

releases.title: In My Prime
releases.synopsis: In the early 1980s, in the small town of Qingwu, the Qi and Cao families with vastly different family dynamics each welcome a new baby: Qi Shi and Cao Xin. Qi Shi, who suffers from albinism, is acutely aware of her difference from a young age, resorting to drinking soy sauce and wearing wigs in a desperate attempt to fit in. Meanwhile, Cao Xin is the quintessential perfect child in other parents' eyes—yet his reputation comes at the cost of his father's harsh demands. When the unconventional, brave, and stubborn girl crosses paths with the well-behaved, disciplined, and high-achieving boy, the two families—already close neighbors—find their lives intertwined through an absurd swapped-at-birth incident. This sparks a journey filled with tears and the chance for rebirth. As the younglings navigate the trials of family, friendship, and romance, the grown-ups grapple with their career, marriage, and family life. In the torrent of time filled with ups and downs, they heal and grow hand in hand, striving to find their calling and true happiness."In My Prime" is a period family drama series adapted from Han Shisan's novel "Close Neighbors (Jin Lin)."

releases.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily
releases.synopsis: Reporting that helps global leaders stay ahead, plus insight on the people, companies and trends.

releases.title: The Legendary Chitose-Sama
releases.synopsis: Lady Jun Qinglan's family is wiped out in a massacre. Her former fiancé, Li Congyao, not only refuses to help but personally disfigures her. She barely escapes with her life, changes her identity, disguises herself as a man, and becomes a coroner at the Dali Temple — biding her time, waiting for the chance to seek justice and revenge. But when she crosses paths with Li Congyao again, the man she once loved has become a ruthless and cruel prince, who forcibly takes her and holds her captive. Caught between love and hatred, intrigue and betrayal, layers of old mysteries begin to surface — and a deadly game of vengeance and desire begins anew.

releases.title: Dreams of Freedom
releases.synopsis: Begoña Montes is a woman who lives trapped in a toxic marriage and seeks the long-awaited freedom in Spain in 1958.

releases.title: Bloomberg Open Interest
releases.synopsis: Delivers the market-moving news you need to know to get a jump start on the US trading day.

releases.title: The Exchange

releases.title: The Claman Countdown
releases.synopsis: The close of the trading day is covered.

releases.title: The Will Cain Show
releases.synopsis: Featuring conversations with newsmakers from across politics, business, culture and sports, The Will Cain Show will offer a comprehensive look at the news of the day in a signature podcast style.

releases.title: The Evening Edit
releases.synopsis: Host Elizabeth MacDonald interviews industry experts to get the inside scoop on the day's leading headlines as they relate to your wallet.

releases.title: Fragments of Truth
releases.synopsis: Orphaned at a young age, Han Ning loses his sister in a bizarre kidnapping case. Determined to seek justice, he becomes a detective, using his natural profiling talent to catch criminals. When a strange murder takes place, it triggers a chain of subsequent homicides, and every single case is somehow tied to the unsolved disappearance of Han Ning's sister seven years ago...

releases.title: Kilder til begeistring
releases.synopsis: Everyday life is full of things to be happy about, you just have to notice them. Every Monday for 52 weeks, we present a new source of excitement.

releases.title: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle
releases.synopsis: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle, utilizing her extensive Wall Street background to analyze the high-stakes intersection of money, power, and politics, Stephanie Ruhle delivers original reporting and hard-hitting interviews on the stories that directly affect Americans' lives. The program focuses on business and political news, featuring the "Nightcap" roundtable segment from her previous show, The 11th Hour

releases.title: The Bottom Line
releases.synopsis: Dagen McDowell and Sean Duffy take on the hotly debated issues in the business and political world, plus the kitchen table topics that matter most to Americans.

releases.title: ОПГ
releases.synopsis: "OPG" is a good comedy about how it's never too late to change and change the world for the better. The series' main character is a provincial bandit nicknamed Vorkuta, who lived by the motto from "Boomer": "It's not us who are like that - it's life." But the "dashing 90s" ended, and he got a prison term. In 2024, the hero is released, where he will have to make amends to those whose lives he ruined. Vorkuta turns to his former accomplices for help, who were never able to find themselves in a new life. The Socially Useful Group enthusiastically embarks on the path of correction and begins to help the townspeople.

releases.title: The Underworld
releases.synopsis: As Shicheng City rises with the logistics boom, gang violence spreads across the city. Undercover officer Ling Che is forced to partner with street hustler Shen Yanlin. What begins as a clash of enemies slowly turns into an unbreakable bond. But as they dig deeper, betrayal emerges from within and corruption runs through the police force. When loyalty becomes a weapon and justice becomes a bargaining chip, a deadly battle between right and wrong is about to unfold...

releases.title: No.9 Hunter
releases.synopsis: Since time immemorial, the Sky Rift has unleashed demonic chaos upon the mortal world. Shangguan Ziyan, a young demoness, and Yuanchu, a Taoist priest, are brought together by fate. As the two No.9 Hunters, they set out on a journey to mend the heavens. Ziyan is afflicted with the Stone Curse, which constantly reverses her yin and yang, shifting her between male and female. Yuanchu, meanwhile, is bound by a cruel fate: whom he loves shall perish. Through all their encounters with humans and demons alike, they come to realize that only their love can serve as the thread to patch the sky and save the world.

releases.title: Phoenix Sleuth
releases.synopsis: In the early years of the Republic of China, a bizarre police death case and a high-profile wealthy merchant murder case made headlines across all newspapers, with the perpetrator's identity shrouded in total mystery. No police officers could make any headway in the investigation. The victim's fiancée, Jiang Siyao, a once-famous teen detective who had retired for years, teamed up with her best friend Huo Yining, a policewoman, to track down the killers of her fiancé and father. With the help of Ye Shi'an, a wealthy young heir hiding his real identity, the three went through countless dangers along the way. Jiang Siyao not only deepened her bond with her best friend, but also developed a romantic spark with Ye Shi'an. After solving a series of connected unsolved cases one after another, the trio finally eradicated the evil forces that had lurked for years and untangled the long-held knot in Jiang Siyao's heart. As the investigation progressed, Jiang Siyao discovered that her fiancé, whom she thought was dead, was actually alive and had returned under a completely new identity.

releases.title: Mao Xue Woof
releases.synopsis: Mao Xue Woof is a scene-based reality show variety show with the relationship of original friends as the starting point. The program takes friendship as the link, and takes "Mao Xue Woof's Home" as the main shooting scene, telling the real and interesting stories of Mao Bu, Li Xueqin and their friends who meet here every week, tearing apart the status quo of daily life in laughter, showing the rich youth life and spiritual world of young people and recording the real growth. The program is broadcast every week all the year round, bringing companionship and emotional health healing to the hard-working young people in the city.

releases.title: Bloomberg Brief
releases.synopsis: Delivers the market news, data and analysis you need to set your agenda.

releases.title: Morning Call
releases.synopsis: Morning Call, anchored by Morgan Brennan, delivers the essential market intelligence that drives the trading day ahead. The program captures breaking business news as it unfolds and tracks pre‑market equity moves, commodity swings, U.S. futures, and overnight action across global markets.

releases.title: The Big Money Show
releases.synopsis: Taylor Riggs, Brian Brenberg and Jackie DeAngelis host an informative and fast-paced hour filled with business topics that impact everyone from Wall Street to the average person.

releases.title: Kudlow
releases.synopsis: Host Larry Kudlow leads roundtable discussions on the policies impacting the domestic and global economies and interviews with business influencers across the world.

releases.title: The Long Watch
releases.synopsis: A major leak case around the turn of the century strikes at the heart of cross-strait dynamics, masking a sharp battle between foreign operatives and our own forces along the covert front. In the late 1990s, an unlikely mentor-apprentice duo at Minzhou's State Security Bureau, with starkly different temperaments, are thrown together by fate to serve the same mission and faith. They manage to thwart multiple schemes, but their lives remain tangled with their enemy across a twenty-year span. As the new era reshapes the balance of power in national security, the hidden war continues without pause. Again and again tested by human nature, the three see their bonds and destinies silently transformed by the choices they make through time.

releases.title: The Rewatchables
releases.synopsis: Bill Simmons and a roundtable of movie lovers from the Ringer universe discuss movies they can’t seem to stop watching.

releases.title: See You Later... Maybe
releases.synopsis: In Huanxi City, Fang Haowen's pen is the cheapest weapon there is. It cannot produce bestsellers, yet it can cut through the absurdity of reality. Recognized by businesswoman Jin Furong, he rises to fame overnight, only to crash back down after turning down her love. A drunken fall from a building and a staged "suicide" farce push him into the eye of the internet storm, as his former agent eggs him on to "trade death for sales" and regain viral fame. Then obsessive fan Bie Fan shows up and wrecks the whole carefully scripted livestream scam. That's how the "Jiong Tu" duo comes to be: a has-been writer and his delusional young fan launching into a wild, can't-live-can't-die escapade.

releases.title: Only Connect
releases.synopsis: The fiendishly difficult quiz show in which two teams of three contestants have to find the connection between seemingly unrelated clues, where patience and lateral thinking are as vital as knowledge.

releases.title: Global Eye
releases.synopsis: Award-winning investigations - revealing secrets, rooting out injustice, and exposing crime, corruption, and abuse. The biggest stories from BBC correspondents all over the world.

releases.title: Evadidos
releases.synopsis: Evadidos is set in an alternate 1980s Portugal where a repressive, authoritarian dictatorship took over much of the world following World War II. The plot follows a protagonist living in the shadows who helps dissidents escape the oppressive regime.

releases.title: Swallowed Star
releases.synopsis: On the Earth, a catastrophe triggered the variation of all kinds of species. The superior survived and the inferior were extinct. Under this circumstance, Luo Feng inherited from the owner of Yunmo Star and became one of the three strongest people on the Earth. He lost his flesh during the fight against giant swallowed monster but then he took the flesh of the monster. In the flesh, he developed a human body. Later, he stepped out of the Earth and headed to the universe.

releases.title: Supreme God Emperor
releases.synopsis: Ten thousand years after his betrayal, Immortal King Mu Yun awakens in the body of a "useless" young man. With hidden alchemy skills and the Slaughter Immortal Diagram, he cures Qin Mengyao, uncovering her Ice Phoenix spirit. As their bond grows, jealous rival Dongfang Yu seeks revenge. Mu Yun embarks on a training journey—unaware assassins await their chance to strike.

releases.title: University Challenge
releases.synopsis: Academic quiz show where teams of students from UK universities answer questions on all manner of subjects.

releases.title: Vigil
releases.synopsis: The mysterious disappearance of a Scottish fishing trawler and a death on-board the submarine HMS Vigil bring the police into conflict with the Navy and British security services. DCI Amy Silva and DS Kirsten Longacre lead an investigation on land and at sea into a conspiracy that goes to the very heart of Britain’s national security.

releases.title: Quotidien
releases.synopsis: Quotidien (nicknamed "The French Show with the Good Lighting" abroad) is a French daily infotainment television program broadcast in the early evening on TMC since September 12, 2016. The show is hosted by Yann Barthès and produced by Bangumi. It consists of segments and reports produced by the team of commentators and journalists surrounding Yann Barthès and features daily guests including newsmakers, intellectuals, politicians, and French and international celebrities.

releases.title: Ici tout commence
releases.synopsis: This television drama series is centered around the prestigious culinary school of renowned chef Auguste Armand. The show follows the lives of students and staff as they navigate the challenges and pressures of the culinary world—delving into their personal and professional lives, revealing secrets, rivalries, and complex relationships.

releases.title: Suidooster
releases.synopsis: Suidooster is a South African television soap opera produced by Suidooster Films which revolves around a matriarch, her family, friends and the people of Suidooster, a small shopping and business centre in the fictional Cape Town suburb of Ruiterbosch.

releases.title: All American
releases.synopsis: When a rising high school football player from South Central L.A. is recruited to play for Beverly Hills High, the wins, losses and struggles of two families from vastly different worlds - Compton and Beverly Hills - begin to collide. Inspired by the life of pro football player Spencer Paysinger.

releases.title: Dahoam is Dahoam
releases.synopsis: The lives of the residents of the fictitious village of Lansing in Upper Bavaria.

releases.title: TMZ

releases.synopsis: The lives and loves of the residents of Ferndale.

releases.synopsis: Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

releases.title: Theatre of Darkness: Yamishibai
releases.synopsis: Yamishibai is a picture-story style of animation whose motif is surrounded and based off the rumors, and urban legends throughout the history of Japan.

releases.title: RE: European Stories
releases.synopsis: Discover Europe in all its diversity of viewpoints

releases.title: Point of View
releases.synopsis: Since its 1988 premiere, this critically acclaimed documentary series has presented hundreds of films that put a human face on contemporary social issues by relating a compelling story in an intimate fashion. "POV" has won virtually every major film and broadcasting award available, including 38 Emmys, 22 Peabody Awards and three Oscars.

releases.title: The Block
releases.synopsis: Couples compete against each other to renovate houses and sell them at auction for the highest price.

releases.title: Vandaag Inside
releases.synopsis: Vandaag Inside is a late-night talk show that airs on SBS6 in the Netherlands. It's known for its lively discussions, often revolving around current events, politics, and social issues, but with a bit of humor and controversy mixed in. The program has a unique dynamic because it features a combination of light-hearted banter and in-depth discussions about more serious topics.

releases.title: Hollyoaks
releases.synopsis: The daily soap that follows the loves, lives and misdemeanours of a group of people living in the Chester village of Hollyoaks where anything could, and frequently does, happen...

releases.title: Pushpa Impossible
releases.synopsis: Pushpa Impossible is the story about a feisty middle-aged woman having studied until grade 9 in a Gujarati medium school and going back to school at the age of 44! She is boisterous, uncouth, impulsive, hardworking and an endearingly loveable mother of three children. She is Pushpa Patel hailing from a small town Patan in Gujarat and now residing at Bapodra Chawl in Mumbai. The show is a peek into her day-to-day struggles, her small victories, her Juggad, her shortcomings, and her constant pursuit of living a good life while struggling as a full-time mother and part-time businesswoman. The show is an autobiography of a mother, who decides to go back to school and change her life by impacting many lives!

releases.title: Have You Been Paying Attention?
releases.synopsis: Topical comedy-quiz show featuring five guests competing to see who can remember the most about events of the week. A fast-paced, funny look at international affairs, politics, sport and entertainment news, we test just how well our contestants have been paying attention.

releases.title: Game Changer
releases.synopsis: In this game show, the game changes every show! Players begin each round without knowing the rules -- and must figure them out while competing to win.

releases.title: The Eternal Supreme, Li Yunxiao
releases.synopsis: Once hailed as the third-strongest expert on the Tianwu Continent, Martial Emperor Gu Feiyang found his cultivation trapped at its peak by the very laws of the world. To break through his limits, he orchestrated an audacious plan, sacrificing everything to reincarnate and begin anew. Reborn as Li Yunxiao, a fifteen-year-old heir of a powerful military family in the Kingdom of Tianshui, he finds himself caught in a storm of invasion, royal succession struggles, and political intrigue. While others fight for power and status, Li Yunxiao sees the bigger picture. Armed with the wisdom and experience of a former Martial Emperor, he calmly overcomes every obstacle on his path toward a single goal: completing the grand design he began in his previous life and laying the foundation for true godhood.

releases.title: Com si fos ahir
releases.synopsis: A group of high school friends meet again after 25 years to attend the funeral of a mutual friend, and from that point on they try to recover their friendship.

releases.title: Antigang
releases.synopsis: The show follows a special police unit dedicated to fighting organized crime and major criminal networks, including street gangs, biker gangs, Italian/Irish/Lebanese mafias, and Mexican cartels.

releases.title: Mastermind
releases.synopsis:
Mastermind is a British quiz show, well known for its challenging questions, intimidating setting and air of seriousness.

Devised by Bill Wright, the basic format of Mastermind has never changed — four and in later contests five contestants face two rounds, one on a specialised subject of the contestant's choice, the other a general knowledge round. Wright drew inspiration from his experiences of being interrogated by the Gestapo during World War II.

The atmosphere is helped by Mastermind's famously ominous theme music, "Approaching Menace" by the British composer Neil Richardson. The quiz programme originated and was recorded in Manchester at studios such as New Broadcasting House and Granada Studios, before permanently moving to MediaCityUK in 2011.

releases.title: The First Years
releases.synopsis: The First Years is a Dutch series for young people in which real-life situations are recreated. The series sheds light on subjects that pupils in the first year of secondary school may be confronted with.

releases.title: Bom Dia Brasil

releases.title: Télématin
releases.synopsis:
Télématin is a French breakfast television news show, broadcast on France 2 since January 7, 1985. It is broadcast in Metropolitan France weekdays from 6:30 to 9:00 am CET. TV5 broadcast the show in Canada in its entirety until September 2011: it now shows a 90 minute version between 6:30 and 8:00 am Eastern Time, when the French original version is now 2h30 long.

Télématin is hosted by William Leymergie. The show is daily seen by around 40% of the French morning audience, a very high percentage for French TV.

In Metropolitan France, the newscasts are presented at 7:00, 7:30 and 8:00, with newsflashes at 6:30 and 8:50, and two press reviews at 7:20 and 8:30. The 6:30, 7:30 and 8:50 newscasts are usually presented by a female reader and the hourly newscasts by a male. The usual readers are Nathanaël de Rinquesen, Sophie Le Saint, Julien Benedetto, Sophie Gastrain, Patrice Romedenne and Frédéric Vion.

releases.synopsis: Follows an environmental and Indigenous rights activist from the Karen group who is killed after protesting the forced eviction of his village from a protected forest.

releases.title: Vaulder
releases.synopsis: Something stalks a group at night in the suburbs.

releases.title: Sometimes Sadness, Sometimes Rebellion
releases.synopsis: Eva is just passing through Madrid. She spends her days there alone: she doesn't know anyone and isn’t particularly interested in getting to know new people. The city is therefore an unfamiliar place where she wanders aimlessly, her curiosity somewhat dampened. But one afternoon, at the Reina Sofía Museum, a man approaches her. His name is Dante and he is an Argentine historian researching labor struggles in his country and the career of Juan Bialet Massé.

releases.title: Conversation with the Sea
releases.synopsis: In Jerusalem, Kamal, a 60-year-old Palestinian man, is ordered by an Israeli court to pay a large social security debt allegedly owed by his son Wael. But Wael drowned in the Red Sea decades ago. When no official record of his death can be found, Kamal follows the only remaining lead to uncover what happened to his son.

releases.title: Musical Touken Ranbu: Tsukiyo Ichiru
releases.synopsis: Musical Adaptation of Touken Ranbu

releases.title: Midnight Knocks at the Door
releases.synopsis: Stripped of color and clothes, ready to be cleansed. A young man's midnight bath becomes a surreal nightmare the moment he realizes he is not alone.

releases.title: Drowning
releases.synopsis: Pietro is driving to Puglia with Jacopo, his autistic son, when their car suddenly breaks down. They are helped by Oliviero, a local mechanic, and are able to stay with Agata, who owns a bar that once rented out rooms. Gaia, who helps Agata run the bar, develops a close relationship with Pietro. The pace of life in the small village is very slow and monotonous, like a long wait for something to happen, until something distressing does, stopping Pietro and Jacopo from resuming their journey.

releases.title: Filling the void
releases.synopsis: A portrait of Magali Garçon, a professor at the Cherbourg School of Arts, whose convictions, feminist vision, and committed personality challenge the traditional art academy, bringing a unique and transformative perspective to her teaching.

releases.title: The Spirit Lock
releases.synopsis: Desperate to save their possessed son, a fractured couple turns to a cursed Pagan device—unleashing a greater evil that threatens their sanity, their marriage, and their souls.

releases.title: Before the War
releases.synopsis: Guido, in his early twenties, lives in a small town in Northern Italy. He has earned respect from his peers through violence in the racist and macho environment he grew up in. But when he meets Sonia, a Kosovar immigrant, something shifts. Guido finds himself torn between the world that made him and the one she’s opening up for him.

releases.title: The Pervert's Guide to Utopias
releases.synopsis: Philosopher Slavoj Žižek is our guide through landscapes of classic film, music, social media, archive and webcasts. Making unexpected twists and turns, he maps the utopian illusions of our times. Through absurd juxtapositions and startling insights, we are seduced into recognising our fate, in order to change it.

releases.title: Bonfire
releases.synopsis: Electronic musician CIFIKA releases her third album, Bonfire. Having built everything alone until now, she chooses a band sound for the first time, and takes to the road in Australia as a five-piece.

releases.title: Blue Danube
releases.synopsis: In Lezama, fashion designer Óscar Barbosa defied the social norms of his time and environment, becoming synonymous with fashion and sexual identity. In the 1960s, he returned to his hometown with his partner, which would spark an artistic adventure that marked a before and after in the local community. "Danubio azul" is a kaleidoscope of stories that intertwine, contradict one another, and pile up to sketch the profile of a man who, over time, became a myth.

releases.title: Bro
releases.synopsis: Summer 2024 was an unforgettable time when many found the dream to become famous—including Lukas, whose cousin decided it was the perfect moment to make a move. But as they plunge into the world of ambition and pop culture, they face the ultimate question: at what cost?

releases.title: Транзит
releases.synopsis: A documentary road movie about a funeral home driver whose job is to deliver the bodies of the deceased to their "small homeland."

releases.title: JunkTown: Far Away and Long Ago
releases.synopsis: Ten years after JunkTown: A Love Letter, Hunter Whaley returns to Colorado to help spread his grandfather's ashes. Much has changed, little has stayed the same. From the rapidly developing sprawl of Grand Junction to the unpaved roads of Yampa, Far Away and Long Ago is an ode to the passage of time and the lasting bonds of friends and family.

releases.title: Remembering Wes Craven: His Life, Legacy and Nightmares
releases.synopsis: Feature-length portrait piece on the career of Wes Craven, including contributions from his closest collaborators.

releases.title: Betrayal and Retribution - The Spawn of the Last House on the Left
releases.synopsis: A rape-and-revenge-themed supplementary feature to Wes Craven's "The Last House on the Left" with more than eleven interviews that map out the genre's connective tissue between the US and Italy.

releases.title: Dear Debbie
releases.synopsis:
Sometimes, enough is enough…

Debbie Mullen is losing it. For years, she has compiled all of her best advice into her column, Dear Debbie, where the wives of New England come for sympathy and neighborly advice. Through her work, Debbie has heard from countless women who are ignored, belittled, or even abused by their husbands. And Debbie does her best to guide them in the right direction. Or at least, she did.

These days, Debbie’s life seems to be spiraling out of control. She just lost her job. Something strange is happening with her teenage daughters. And her husband is keeping secrets, according to the tracking app she installed on his phone. Now, Debbie’s done being the bigger person.

She’s done being reasonable and practical. It’s time to take her own advice.

And now it’s time for payback against all the people in her life who deserve it the most.

releases.title: Persona
releases.synopsis:
**A trans woman discovers pornography of herself she has no memory of making, only to find herself led to an unimaginably deeper evil.**

A feral shut-in discovers a disturbing internet porn video of what seems to be herself. A seance of coked-up artists summons unearthly forces in a studio apartment. The staircase of an exurban marketing company descends endlessly beneath the earth. 

In Aoife Josie Clements’ electric, nightmarish, intricately layered novel, the impossibility of goodness crowds in upon two young trans women barely surviving on sex work and zero-hours contracts. Below the familiar evils of capitalism and the bottomless depths of internet culture, a darker horror awaits. What curse follows these women? What are they escaping? What are they running towards?

releases.title: KYOTO lo sguardo del drago
releases.synopsis: Un fantasy thriller, come in un film, dal lusso degli yacht di Portofino ai ruderi di un antico castello in Giappone. Il prezioso pugnale del samurai demone Nobunaga è scomparso. Michele, geniale decifratore di codici segreti, Alexander, affascinante milionario irlandese, Gretel, eclettica signora, e Yoshida, investigatore privato, sono i fantastici quattro che indagano per svelare il mistero in un crescendo da vivere minuto dopo minuto: gli azzardi, i ninja, l'onore e l'amicizia, l'amore e la morte. Tragica e fiabesca, cinica e poetica, una storia dura ammantata di dolcezza ed elegante ironia fino alla spietata soluzione.

releases.title: The Man Who Vanished
releases.synopsis:
**What would you become  if no one could see you?**

A gripping psychological thriller of invisibility, obsession, and power. Deep within Egypt, a discovery changes everything. When I encounter something never meant to be found, my world fractures. I vanish from sight—but not from consequence. Liberation mutates into obsession, freedom into a mind slipping beyond control.

Unseen, I move through the world’s shadows—navigating criminal networks, exposing hidden conspiracies, unearthing truths buried for centuries. Invisibility becomes more than an ability: it becomes temptation, weapon, and curse.

Each step deeper into the unseen erodes the boundaries between justice and transgression, control and compulsion. But the greatest danger is not the enemies I pursue. It is the darkness awakening within me. As curiosity hardens into obsession, morality fractures.

Some hungers leave scars you cannot see. And when power begins to consume rather than empower, survival becomes a battle not only against those who hunt me—but against the consequences of everything I have done. 

The Man Who Vanished is a gripping psychological thriller fused with political intrigue, conspiracies and espionage suspense. Relentless tension meets psychological depth in a story about invisibility, obsession, and the devastating cost of crossing unseen lines.

Perfect for readers who love:

✔ Psychological thrillers
✔ Political and conspiracy thrillers
✔ Espionage and spy fiction
✔ Dark suspense and moral dilemmas
✔ High-stakes international intrigue

Fans of high-tension, mind-bending thrillers and stories of identity, secrecy, and psychological descent will be captivated by its atmosphere, intensity, and escalating suspense. 
Are you ready to vanish into the unseen?

Notice: Contains mature themes and strong scenes intended for mature readers.

releases.title: Titanium, The Life & Memoirs Of Toby Ti Mustard
releases.synopsis: Titanium: Life of X is a raw, visionary memoir by ordained minister and creative leader Toby Ti Mustard. This spiritual autobiography traces a journey of awakening, reincarnation, and resilience — a life forged in silence, shaped by struggle, and elevated by purpose. Set against the backdrop of Ross County, Ohio, Toby’s story unfolds through mystical insight, personal transformation, and a calling to serve. Titanium is not just a book — it’s a declaration of identity, a spiritual blueprint, and a testament to the unbreakable force of becoming.

releases.title: The Beeston Genesis
releases.synopsis: A historical and analytical study examining the role of Robert William Felkin in the formation and codification of modern Western Tarot systems. The paper situates Felkin’s work within the intellectual and social context of Beeston, Nottinghamshire, and traces how these early influences informed later Golden Dawn Tarot structures.

releases.title: A Good Person
releases.synopsis:
Lillian and Henry have been enjoying each other’s company, especially in bed. Even though Lillian’s best friend calls it “situationship,” Lillian is determined to lock Henry down—and she has a plan. She’ll be the best, most accommodating version of herself until he falls in love with her. But when Henry blindsides Lillian with a breakup, Lillian exacts revenge by performing a drunken hex on him.

Lillian expects Henry to come crawling back to her. What she doesn’t quite anticipate is becoming a prime suspect in his murder case when he’s found dead. As Lillian grapples with the loss of her sort-of-boyfriend, she’s hit with another reckoning: That Henry had a long-term girlfriend he also left behind.

Desperate to control the narrative, clear her name, and assume her rightful place as Henry’s mourning girlfriend, Lillian’s pursuit of the truth will throw her into a dangerous tailspin.

releases.title: Tiny Steps Giant Leaps
releases.synopsis:
The book '**Tiny Steps Giant Leaps**' was written by the author **Chowdhury Tauhid Mahmud** aka Radi. He has expertise in teaching children for around two decades. He came up with this book, so that readers can come back to the habit of reading books and naturally stays away from screen time as much as possible. 
The book is unique because the readers have to read and write lots of activities which will help to boost their creativity.

releases.title: The Escape Game
releases.synopsis:
**It’s all fun and games until someone ends up dead.**

Six months ago, season four of The Escape Game ended in horror when contestant Alicia Angelos was found murdered on set.

Now season five is underway, and new contestants are ready to put their skills to the test solving the show's trickiest escape rooms. There's Adi, the cryptographer; Carter, the math whiz; Beck, the wannabe game master; and . . . Sierra Angelos, the girl who got away with her sister’s murder. Or so everyone believes.

But Sierra’s not just here to win. She’s here for justice.

When the contestants begin uncovering clues that hint at the identity of Alicia’s true killer, it becomes clear that the stakes aren’t high just in this competition—they’re deadly. If these teens want to win—and survive—the game, they must solve the biggest mystery of all: who killed Alicia Angelos?

releases.title: In the Periphery of It All
This House Will Feed
releases.synopsis:
Amidst the devastation of Ireland’s Great Famine, a young woman is salvaged from certain death when offered a mysterious position at a remote manor house haunted by a strange power and the horror of her own memories in this chillingly evocative historical novel braided with gothic horror and supernatural suspense for readers of Katherine Arden’s The Warm Hands of Ghosts and The Silence Factory by Bridget Collins.

County Clare, 1848: In the scant few years since the potato blight first cast its foul shadow over Ireland, Maggie O’Shaughnessy has lost everything—her entire family and the man she trusted with her heart. Toiling in the Ennis Workhouse for paltry rations, she can see no future either within or outside its walls—until the mysterious Lady Catherine arrives to whisk her away to an old mansion in the stark limestone landscape of the Burren.

Lady Catherine wants Maggie to impersonate her late daughter, Wilhelmina, and hoodwink solicitors into releasing Wilhelmina’s widow pension so that Lady Catherine can continue to provide for the villagers in her care. In exchange, Maggie will receive freedom from the workhouse, land of her own, and the one thing she wants more than a chance to fulfill the promise she made to her brother on his deathbed—to live to spite them all.

Launching herself into the daunting task, Maggie plays the role of Wilhelmina as best she can while ignoring the villagers’ tales of ghostly figures and curses. But more worrying are the whispers that come from within. Something in Lady Catherine’s house is reawakening long-buried memories in Maggie—of a foe more terrifying than hunger or greed, of a power that calls for blood and vengeance, and of her own role in a nightmare that demands the darkest sacrifice . . .

releases.title: गुनहग़ार (Gunehgar)
releases.synopsis:
"क्या कोई गुनाह इतना बड़ा हो सकता है कि खुदा की रहमत कम पड़ जाए?"
यह कहानी है फ़ैज़ की, जिसके लिए एक थप्पड़ सिर्फ एक पल की बेइज्जती नहीं थी, बल्कि उसके पूरे वजूद की हार बन गई थी. ज़ोया से किया गया वह इंतिक़ाम उसे एक ऐसे मोड़ पर ले आता है, जहाँ मंज़िल अब कोई मंज़िल नहीं, बल्कि खुद की तलाश है.
यह महज़ एक प्रेम कहानी नहीं है, बल्कि नफरत की आग से शुरू होकर सजदों की शांति तक पहुँचने वाला एक गहरा सफ़र है. फ़ैज़ की गलतियाँ उसे ऐसी गलियों में ले जाती हैं जहाँ पछतावा ही उसका इकलौता साथी है

releases.title: Of Darkness and Desecration
releases.synopsis:
I could cling to hope or hate…
That night, I chose hope.
But I kept hate close by.
Just in case.

The second novel in the Harbingers of Agatharr series continues as our heroes converge.

Celeste, the Herald of Valitharr, races toward the ancient spellweaver stronghold of Lirathmar. But the divine being who whispers in her mind has been called to stand before the Pantheon, and Celeste worries she won’t survive the journey without him.

Caelen, a timid peasant, blames himself for the horrors that have befallen his loved ones and vows never to be paralyzed by fear again. His newfound eagerness finds him in possession of a powerful, ancient ability that threatens to sunder his mind unless he learns to control it.

Brynna, a hardened blacksmith, has sworn to protect Caelen and return him to the remnants of his family in Mossby. But in a world cursed with magic, even the simplest task can be marred by danger.

Their paths have merged, but how do they trust those they barely know when death lurks in every shadow?

releases.title: Love and Other Curses
releases.synopsis:
For the Kingdom. For the magic. And for love . . .

Aurelia Wycherley has found someone to tether her magic to – her enigmatic former enemy, Jules Nightly. Now, they are heading off to coven college to learn advanced magic. But they are also on a secret to discover the Lost Quarter of the college, create their own coven of twelve and try to discover a way to bring back the Old Magic. 

When malevolent magic interrupts their first night at college, Aurelia and Jules discover that Jonathan and his coven of untethered witches has escaped and now they are after her magic, curse and all… 

Can they save the magic and the world - or will Aurelia lose her magic for good?

Prepare for balls, late-night study groups, hidden mysteries, a heist, the return of old foes, and a lot more kissing!

releases.title: Oceanforged
releases.synopsis:
*From the bestselling author of The Grandest Bookshop in the World comes the second instalment of an epic fantasy adventure series in the tradition of Skandar and Percy Jackson.* 

Guided by a mysterious message, Cori, Tarn and Jem sail north to meet the secretive Loyalists, who will help them on their quest for the Oceanforged Armour.

Instead, the Loyalists warn of a looming disaster. Unless Cori can master all the powers of the Champions before it strikes, Aquinta will be doomed.

The Loyalists believe that a piece of armour may be hidden in Mutemount. But sea monsters once lurked in those waters, and no one who has travelled near the silent island in the last century has ever returned…

releases.title: The Writers Retreat
releases.synopsis:
**A wickedly twisty and atmospheric thriller set at a writers' retreat in the South of France, The Writers Retreat is Knives Out meets Anna Downes’ The Safe Place from an exciting new voice in the thriller/mystery space.**

Welcome to The Writers Retreat – a creative haven for writers to hone their plotlines and sharpen their characters while soaking up the Provençal atmosphere. But this year’s retreat offers something different, as real-life blurs with fiction, and suspense isn't contained to the page.

Kat Hale is a bestselling Australian author crumbling under the pressure of writing her second novel. On a whim, she has fled to a writers retreat in the South of France run by internationally acclaimed author Helen Thorne. What Kat hopes will be two blissfully uninterrupted weeks to focus on her writing in anonymity quickly turns into something more sinister, when Kat begins to suspect that Helen isn't quite as perfect as everyone seems to believe.

Will Kat’s drive to uncover the truth about Helen be any match for Helen’s desire to hold onto her career, her reputation and her writing retreat, or is Kat at risk of falling victim to a more dangerous climax?

releases.title: The Radiant Dark
releases.synopsis:
***Arrival meets Wild Dark Shore in this captivating novel that follows a family for over fifty years—a bold and compassionate exploration of the universe around us and what it truly means to be human.***

It’s March 1980, and Carol Girard and her husband are living an ordinary life in a small town in the Adirondacks. They have just had their first child, and though Carol is struggling with the challenges of new motherhood, her future seems clear. Until something extraordinary happens: an inexplicable flickering of light in the sky, which is ultimately determined to be communication from intelligent life on another planet. But these beings are eleven light-years away, and nothing is known about them other than the fact that they seem to know we exist too. And so begins a decades-long exchange of messages with this mysterious, faraway civilization.

As humanity reels from a shifting understanding of its place in the universe, we follow the stories of the Girard family: Carol, whose fascination with this other life sparks a desperate search for spiritual meaning; Michael, her loyal son, who finds solace not in the stars above his head but in the ground beneath his feet; and Ro, Carol’s bright and ambitious daughter, whose childhood goal to work in interstellar communication will evolve into something far grander.

Tracing five decades of love, loss, ambition, and self-discovery, *The Radiant Dark* is a stunning examination of a family navigating their lives with the knowledge that we are not alone.

releases.title: After 9th A Houston Murder Story
releases.synopsis:
The city of Houston does not sleep easily in July.

The heat lingers past midnight, rising from the asphalt in slow, invisible waves, settling over the bayous and the flatlands like a second skin. By the time the rest of the country has pulled on a light jacket and called the evening cool, Houston is still sweating — still exhaling the day's burn into a sky too thick and close to offer relief.

It was in this kind of heat that Donna died.

And it was in this heat that Bill first understood how quickly the world a man builds over a lifetime can be taken from him — not just the woman he loved, but the practice, the purpose, the very stability of his mind and body. All of it. Gone.

He was sixty-two years old when he buried her in his heart, because her family would not let him stand at her grave.

This is that story.

releases.synopsis:
*In the dead of night, passions rise and empires fall.*
*Welcome to Kingdoms of the Compass.*

The Fulcrum is failing, and demons are slipping into the mortal world, stalking the night.

No one is safe.

Especially not Sorrel. An orphan and an outcast, she’s spent her whole life within the walls of her small village, ostracized for her mystical abilities. She wants to survive…and maybe find somewhere she can call her true home. But Fate has other plans.

Sorrel has been chosen. Cursed.

She must cross the Badlands to return the Queen's crown and convince the fearsome female to save their world from destruction.

Well aware she’s no brave hero, Sorrel makes a dangerous deal with Merc, a brooding, commanding mercenary known only by his unscrupulous profession.

The deal? A night in his bed that she will never forget, in exchange for her safe passage.

But Merc has secrets of his own, and even though passion runs hot between them, enemies are around every corner, and danger and betrayal threaten at every turn.

releases.title: Wings of Brotherhood
releases.synopsis:
Wings of Brotherhood: A Journey Between Two Air Forces by Badrul Hassan Khan is an extraordinary Pakistan Air Force memoir that takes readers inside the cockpit, command rooms, and corridors of power across South Asia and the Gulf. From fierce dogfights in West Pakistan during the 1965 war to the heartbreaking betrayals of 1971, this PAF pilot biography book reveals the courage, loyalty, and sacrifices of men who shaped aerial warfare in the region.

Wing Commander Badrul Hassan Khan, one of the rare officers to have fought in both the Indo Pak wars, offers an unfiltered look at how politics, pride, and patriotism collided in the skies. As he moves from the Pakistan Air Force to help build Bahrain’s Air Wing from scratch, readers witness the remarkable evolution of two nations’ military identities.

Packed with gripping battle scenes, behind the scenes accounts of Air Marshal Noor Khan’s leadership, and insider perspectives on military intelligence, this military memoir book captures a defining era of aviation and regional geopolitics. Whether you’re a history enthusiast, a student of Pakistan Air Force history, or simply drawn to tales of valor and vision, Wings of Brotherhood offers an unmatched journey through war, duty, and brotherhood.

A powerful addition to collections of books on the Indo Pak war 1965 and 1971, this is the definitive Pakistan Air Force memoir, a story of ambition, betrayal, and resilience that continues to shape South Asia’s skies.

releases.title: First Freedom
releases.synopsis:
Born in 1926, Opal Lee grew up in a racially divided America and dedicated her life to overcoming the obstacles presented therein. A lifelong educator, Ms. Opal has been a community activist all her life, and would take on the movement to celebrate and commemorate Juneteenth not just as a holiday, but as a symbol of comprehensive freedom for all people.

Ms. Opal’s life personifies the fight for everyday freedom that leads to lasting change. As the Grandmother of Juneteenth says, “There is so much more to do.”

releases.title: To Catch a Fascist
releases.synopsis:
A searing, provocative investigation into the rise of white nationalist and neo-Nazi movements in the United States, centered on the anti-fascist groups working to expose and stop these hateful factions.

Demonized as “extremist” by conservatives and liberals alike, “antifa” became a bogeyman during Donald Trump’s first term. But few Americans understood the dangerous work antifa was doing to disrupt and unmask a new generation of white supremacists or listened when antifa sounded the alarm about these white supremacists taking positions of power. Now this underground network of militant anti-fascists is determined to stop the rising tide of fascism in America. No matter the cost.

In the tradition of in-the-room investigative classics such as The Smartest Guys in the Room and Bad Blood, To Catch a Fascist follows different factions of antifascists as they work to unmask hateful extremists before they commit devastating acts of violence. With searing detail and exclusive reporting, To Catch a Fascist paints a vivid picture of the stakes in this ongoing, often unseen war between opposite ends of the political spectrum, highlighting the scrappy resourcefulness and resilience of anti-fascist movements against their increasingly violent adversaries. Utilizing razor-sharp storytelling and eye-opening insight, this timely and necessary book reveals the human cost, moral dilemmas, and unwavering determination involved in fighting white supremacy.

Both a call to action and a pulse-raising look at the powerful work being done to combat today’s gravest threat to democracy, To Catch a Fascist will inspire you to fight for your community.

releases.title: Intoxicated Ways of Knowing
releases.synopsis:
Intoxicating substances can be found lurking in every corner of modern life, and Matthew Perkins-McVey’s pathbreaking book offers the untold story of how they were implicated in shifting perceptions of embodiment found in the emerging sciences of the body and mind in late-nineteenth-century Germany. Their use in this experimental context gave rise to a dynamic conception of the subject within the scientific, psychological, philosophical, and sociological milieu of the era. The history of the modern biological subject, Perkins-McVey argues, turns on “intoxicated ways of knowing.”
 
Intoxicated Ways of Knowing identifies the state of intoxication as a tacit form of thinking and knowing with the body. Intoxicants force us to feel, intervening directly in our perceptional awareness, and, Perkins-McVey contends, they bring latent conceptual associations into the foreground of conscious thought, engendering new ways of knowing the world. The book unfurls how intoxicants affected nineteenth-century German science and how, ultimately, the connection between mental life and intoxication is taken up in the works of Friedrich Nietzsche, Max Weber, and Sigmund Freud, bringing the biological subject out of the lab and into the worlds of philosophy, psychoanalysis, sociology, and politics.

releases.title: Selecting and Appraising Archives and Manuscripts
releases.synopsis:
Today, we operate in an environment of records abundance, with far more documentation created than can reasonably be kept. Thoughtful selection and appraisal is both a balancing act and a vital skill for modern archivists. Selecting and Appraising Archives and Manuscripts is a concise introduction to the theory and practice of archival selection and appraisal, offering practical tools for principled work.

While much of the existing literature on appraisal is theoretical, this book focuses on practical ideas that are grounded in best practices, informed by the past, and aspirationally moving the profession forward. Divided into six chapters, topics include policy development, ethics and strategies for collecting repositories, tools and methods for analyzing records, appraisal and acquisition in institutional settings, and more. Guidance is centered on intentional collecting, adherence to professional values, and responsible stewardship, and covers a variety of formats.

This volume can be read in a linear way or used as a quick reference in real-life scenarios. Read it in its entirety, or jump to specific chapters as your situation warrants. This volume will help readers feel confident in making thoughtful collection- building decisions.

releases.title: The Generative Revolution
releases.synopsis:
The Generative Revolution provides a concise yet powerful exploration of how Generative
AI is transforming creativity, innovation, and human–machine interaction. Integrating
insights from multiple disciplines, the volume examines core architectures, multimodal
systems, and diverse applications across science, engineering, healthcare, and the arts. It
also addresses key ethical and societal challenges while offering practical guidance for
researchers, educators, technologists, and policymakers. This book serves as a timely

releases.synopsis:
As turmoil simmers within a divided nation, smoke from another blaze begins to rise. Sparked by individual acts of resistance among those enslaved across the American South, their seemingly disparate rebellions fuel a singular inferno of justice, connecting them in ways quiet at times, explosive at others. As these flames rise, so will they.

Luke, quick-witted and literate, and Henri, a man with a strong and defiant spirit, forge an unbreakable bond at a Virginia plantation called Magnolia Row. Both seek escape from unimaginable cruelty. And sure as the fires of hell, Luke and Henri will leave their mark, sparking resistance among the lives they touch…

One is Josephine, a young, sharp, and observant girl who wields silence as her greatest weapon. A witness to Luke and Henri’s resilience, she listens, watches, waits for the moment to make her move.

Then there is Charity Butler, her husband a formerly enslaved man who proved his ferocity as a young boy standing alongside Josephine. At his encouragement, Charity fights for her freedom in court and wins – only to battle a deeply unjust system designed to destroy the life they’ve built.

And finally, there is Nathaniel, who ruthlessly exploits other Black people and mirrors the cruelty of the white men who, like him, are enslavers. A perversion of the system of slavery, his fragile and contradictory rule will become a catalyst of its own.

Birdie Chang didn’t know anything about Whidbey Island when she chose it, only that it was about as far away as she could get from her own life. She’s a woman on the run, desperate for an escape from the headlines back home and the look of concern in her girlfriend’s eyes—and from Calvin Boyer, the man who abused her as a child and who’s now resurfaced. On her way, she has an unnerving encounter with a stranger on the ferry who offers her a proposition, a sinister solution, a plan for revenge.

But Birdie isn’t the only girl Calvin harmed back then. There’s also Linzie King, a former reality TV star who recently wrote all about it in her bestselling memoir. Though the two women have never met, their stories intertwine. Once Birdie arrives on Whidbey, she finally cracks the book’s spine, only to find too much she recognizes in its pages. A complex whodunnit told from alternating points of view, Whidbey is searingly perceptive and astonishingly original. Exploring the long reach of violence and our flawed systems of incarceration and rehabilitation, this is a tense and provocative debut that’s sure to incite crucial questions about the pursuit of justice and who has real power over a story: the one who lives it, or the one who tells it?

releases.title: Innocence, Desire, and the Architecture of the Fall
releases.synopsis:
ABSTRACT
Across John Hawkes’s seventeen novels, the word “grape” appears 129 times, concentrated in the mature “triad” novels and codified in Innocence in Extremis (1985). But the grape does not operate alone. Systematic analysis of seventeen novels reveals a five-part symbolic architecture that existing scholarship has overlooked: the grape functions as threshold catalyst, surrounded by four counter-motifs, camera (1,173 keyword hits), wound (1,814 keyword hits), enclosure (3,167 keyword hits), and child/death (5,569 keyword hits), forming a repeating system whose keywords appear thousands of times across the corpus, markers of motif concentration rather than precise measures of symbolic function. These counts identify where the motifs cluster; they do not quantify symbolic density, and the comparative prevalence figures (child > enclosure > wound > camera > grape) reflect keyword concentration, not confirmed symbolic operation. This study integrates close reading with systematic text analysis to reveal Hawkes as more deliberately architectural, more internally consistent, than anyone has recognized. The debris of his fiction reveals its innate design.

Progress continues while the game is closed. Combat, gathering and crafting run offline, so a returning player finds work already done instead of a backlog to catch up on.

Sixteen professions feed into one another. Mining and smelting supply the forge, farming and fishing supply the kitchen, and cooked food is what keeps a character standing in long fights — there is no pure-combat path through the game.

More than 120 enemies, eight weekly titans and a line of world bosses make up the endgame. Each carries its own damage weakness, loot table and piece of story, and matching a weapon to that weakness matters more than raw numbers. The Ashfall lets a character let go of everything and begin again stronger: the world's own form of prestige, and never a resurrection.

The game is menu- and text-driven rather than action-driven, runs in the browser and as a desktop build, and is fully playable in German and English. It tells no chosen-one story — nobody here is saving the world, and the chronicle never claims otherwise.
